name: The Great Flood
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia World Guide

generalAbilities.name: Scent (Imprecise) 120 feet
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

Scent involves sensing creatures or objects by smell, and is usually a vague sense. The range is listed in the ability, and it functions only if the creature or object being detected emits an aroma (for instance, incorporeal creatures usually do not exude an aroma).

If a creature emits a heavy aroma or is upwind, the GM can double or even triple the range of scent abilities used to detect that creature, and the GM can reduce the range if a creature is downwind.

generalAbilities.name: Bitter Breath
generalAbilities.description:
90 feet.

If a creature ends its turn in the aura, it's exposed to the Great Flood's flood breath disease.

generalAbilities.name: Coordinated Actions
generalAbilities.description: The Great Flood's multiple heads allow them to act on two separate initiatives, rolling initiative twice and acting on both results. They can't Delay. At the start of each of their turns, they gain 2 actions (see Multiple Reactions below for reactions). Any ability that would sever one of the Great Flood's heads doesn't cause the Great Flood to die if they still have at least one head, but it does cause them to lose the additional reaction granted by the severed head.

generalAbilities.name: Multiple Reactions
generalAbilities.description: The Great Flood gains an extra reaction per round for each of its nine heads, which they can use only to make Reactive Strikes with their jaws. They can't use more than 1 reaction on the same triggering action, even if a creature leaves several squares within the Great Flood's reach, and they gain reactions on only their first turn each round.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Flood Breath
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 42 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 Drained 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 Drained 2 (1 day)

Stage 3 drained 2 and Doomed 1 (1 day)

Stage 4 You die and your body collapses, releasing a cloud of toxin. Any creature within 10 feet of your death is exposed to flood breath (1 day)

offensiveAbilities.name: Great Wave
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The Great Flood gathers all nearby water and floods a mile burst. Any creature in the area must succeed at a DC 42 Reflex Saving Throw save or be moved up to 60 feet in a direction of the Great Flood's choice. The area remains flooded with 30-foot-deep water for 1 hour or until the Great Flood dies, then drains naturally.

offensiveAbilities.name: Nine-Jawed Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements It's the Great Flood's second turn in the round (see Coordinated Actions)

Effect The Great Flood Strides or Swims twice, moving through smaller creatures' spaces freely. Each creature they move through or are adjacent to takes (4d8+20) Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 42 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures that fail the save are also exposed to flood breath.
